sources: https://koa.com/campgrounds/mount-pleasant-charleston/ (read in a browser; plain fetches get a Cloudflare challenge)

values.note: Every RV site has water and 50/30/20-amp electric; some (the KOA Patio and lakeside types) also have sewer.

hookups.source: https://koa.com/campgrounds/mount-pleasant-charleston/amenities/ ('Some shared features at all of our RV Sites include: 50, 30 and 20 amps ... Water and electric. Additionally, some of our RV Sites have concrete KOA Patios® and full hookups') + /site-type/rv-camping-sites/ (site types 'PULL THRU, 50/30/20 AMPS, FULL HOOKUPS ...', 'PULL THRU, 50/30/20 AMPS, WATER/ELECTRIC'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: Pull-through and back-in sites, some by the lake and some among the trees; premium lakefront sites 63-71 and B01. Up to 6 people and 2 vehicles per site.

sites.source: https://koa.com/campgrounds/mount-pleasant-charleston/amenities/ ("80' Max Length"; 'We have Pull-Thru and Back-In RV Sites throughout the campground') + /site-type/rv-camping-sites/ ('Premium deluxe sites 63 - 71 ... lakefront sites') + /general-information/ ('Only 2 vehicles per site'; 'Maximum of 6 people per site'), read 2026-10-21

facilities.source: https://koa.com/campgrounds/mount-pleasant-charleston/amenities/ ('Wi-Fi'; 'Hunt Brothers Pizza - made to order in the gift store'; Propane, Firewood, Kamping Kitchen), read 2026-10-21

values.note: Book on koa.com or 1-843-849-5177. RV sites need 7 days' notice to cancel. Rates are for 2 adults and 2 children; extra adults $8 a night, extra children $6. Check-in 1 pm, check-out noon. The park states two-night minimums for Deluxe Cabins and weekend tent/cabin stays, and may set holiday minimums; none for RV sites.

booking.source: https://koa.com/campgrounds/mount-pleasant-charleston/general-information/ ('Check-in time on all RV and tent sites is 1:00 p.m., check-out time is 12:00 p.m.'; 'RV & Tent Sites: You must give 7 days cancellation notice'; 'All rates are based on a family of four ... Additional adults are $8/ea/night, additional kids are $6/ea/night'; 'Minimum Stay: A two-night minimum stay is required for all Deluxe Cabins ...'), read 2026-10-21

discounts.source: https://koa.com/campgrounds/mount-pleasant-charleston/ (no standing military discount stated, only a 'Military Appreciation Week' event; the derived value rested only on the Good Sam directory), read 2026-10-21

note: KOA Holiday at 3157 N Highway 17, Mount Pleasant, on the grounds of Oakland Plantation beside a 30-acre fishing lake; pool open March-October. --Claude
summary: koa.com confirms year-round operation, 50/30/20-amp water+electric at every RV site with full hookups at some, pull-throughs, 80-ft max length, Wi-Fi and a gift store. Fees left as quoted 2026-10-19 ($84.99-329.99; price gate lifted by the Charleston gateway, 17 km). Cleared the directory-only military flag. Note trimmed of prices, rating and hookups. Not stated: site count, showers, laundry, dump.
